deliverables.requirement: A documented architecture
deliverables.note: Documents ownership, data, training, inference, evaluation, provenance, trust, and deployment boundaries.

deliverables.requirement: A completed first-evidence vertical slice with 20 to 50 task-aligned cases, three baselines, a smoke fine-tune, a shared results table, and a failure analysis
deliverables.note: Contains 24 cases, three initial prompt baselines, real smoke LoRA, corrected shared comparison, and rejection analysis.

deliverables.requirement: Reproducible source and rights manifests
deliverables.note: All eleven sources have route evidence, conservative rights, availability, profile, evaluation, and run metadata.

deliverables.requirement: Data ingestion and sanitization code
deliverables.note: Typed local-file adapters and project-owned dataset compilers preserve provenance and reject unsafe drift.

deliverables.requirement: Train/eval contamination checks
deliverables.note: Lineage, normalized hash, and exact contiguous 12-word n-gram checks passed against B1.

deliverables.requirement: Adapters for the requested external evaluations
deliverables.note: Seven adapters are tested; six suite IDs were adapted from exact real source artifacts without claiming scores.

deliverables.requirement: A versioned GoodProse custom benchmark
deliverables.note: B1 v1 cases, schema, manifest, preregistration, and v1.1 scorer correction rebuild deterministically.

deliverables.requirement: Four-tier evaluation handling including B1, B2, Tier C, and intended-audience human evaluation
deliverables.note: All handling protocols and typed lifecycle boundaries are implemented; true B2, Tier C, and Tier D execution remain separate stopping conditions.

deliverables.requirement: Baseline configurations and results
deliverables.note: Prompt, retrieval, structured, local scale, external ceiling, and matched MLX controls are recorded.

deliverables.requirement: Fine-tuning configurations
deliverables.note: Exact base, data, framework, LoRA, optimization, checkpoint, hardware, and cost pins are committed.

deliverables.requirement: At least one completed real fine-tuning run
deliverables.note: Two genuine LoRA updates completed and were retained as negative quality evidence.

deliverables.requirement: Source-specific run configurations for all eleven named people
deliverables.note: Exactly eleven validated descriptive source-profile configs exist.

deliverables.requirement: Standalone runs wherever approved data is sufficient plus lower-cost coverage for every other profile
deliverables.note: Zero profiles meet both frozen rights and sufficiency gates; every profile received real neutral and paired-topic source-text-free coverage.

deliverables.requirement: A unified-model training run
deliverables.note: A real unified profile-conditioned LoRA ran and was rejected for quality and memorization risk.

deliverables.requirement: A matched direct-generation versus structured plan-write-verify/revise comparison
deliverables.note: Single-pass, four-stage, compact two-stage, and matched base/adapter inference were compared; the four-stage variant regressed.

deliverables.requirement: A provenance-aware best-of-N experiment when rights-safe teacher access is available
deliverables.note: No authentic training-approved corpus and rights-safe teacher path exists; the user also prohibited Ox Alpha from authoring training examples.

deliverables.requirement: Evaluation reports with paired effects, confidence intervals, judge-bias diagnostics, and confirmatory versus exploratory labels
deliverables.note: Powered comparisons include paired effects and intervals. No LLM judge was decisive, so judge-bias and judge-human diagnostics are explicitly not applicable yet.

deliverables.requirement: A three-corpus training data model covering task pairs, style targets, and preference pairs
deliverables.note: The unified compiler and 90-record project-owned pilot exercise all three corpus types with frozen ratios.

deliverables.requirement: Content-controlled style evaluation, adversarial fidelity cases, and memorization checks
deliverables.note: Neutral shared cases, paired topic swaps, adversarial B1 features, exact training-label leakage, repetition, and n-gram contamination checks are implemented. Dated controls remain required only for future corpus-trained profiles.

deliverables.requirement: A frozen set of three to five finalists and an automatically selected compact blinded human packet
deliverables.note: The 15-candidate frontier contains zero finalist-ready candidates; creating a packet would violate readiness rules.

deliverables.requirement: Final human results when ratings are returned, otherwise a provisional report and active continuation plan
deliverables.note: The provisional report and protocol exist; no valid packet or intended-audience ratings can exist before finalist readiness.

deliverables.requirement: Experiment history
deliverables.note: Preregistrations, executions, corrections, invalidations, failures, hypotheses, and decisions are retained.

deliverables.requirement: Cost and hardware analysis
deliverables.note: Settled spend, remaining budget, local memory/disk/latency, model size, and planning tiers are reported.

deliverables.requirement: Model cards
deliverables.note: Cards cover the genuine tuned unified candidate and the provisional local research leader.

deliverables.requirement: Dataset cards
deliverables.note: Both training datasets document composition, rights, provenance, isolation, limitations, and rebuild commands.

deliverables.requirement: A recommended production architecture
deliverables.note: Evidence supports a no-deployment recommendation only; compact ledger/draft is a research leader, not a production recommendation.

deliverables.requirement: A simple interface for applying the selected model/profile
deliverables.note: The local command validates exact model pins, omits source text from results, refuses overwrite, and requires manual review.

deliverables.requirement: Clear instructions for reproducing ingestion, training, evaluation, and inference
deliverables.note: The runbook distinguishes committed-byte validation, ignored-artifact prerequisites, genuine execution, and external trust boundaries.

stopping_conditions.requirement: External evaluations integrated or documented with tested adapters and acquisition steps
stopping_conditions.note: All requested suites have tested adapters; licensing/judge residuals are explicit.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Four-tier evaluation program implemented, versioned, documented, and safely split
stopping_conditions.note: Implementation and synthetic lifecycle tests pass without exposing hidden content.

stopping_conditions.requirement: First-evidence vertical slice and shared failure analysis committed
All eleven sources have audits, rights, profiles, evaluation coverage, and configs
stopping_conditions.note: Completed with neutral and paired-topic source-text-free coverage.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Every eligible profile has standalone training and every other profile meaningful lower-cost coverage plus blocker
stopping_conditions.note: No profile is eligible; all eleven received two real lower-cost coverage experiments and explicit blockers.

stopping_conditions.requirement: At least one unified controllable model completed a real training run
Prompt, retrieval, direct, structured, unified fine-tune, and justified adapter alternatives compared
stopping_conditions.note: The common frontier contains 15 matched or explicitly bounded candidates across the required branches.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Selected candidate passes every hard gate without unacceptable regression
stopping_conditions.note: The research leader passes only 12/24 visible B1 hard gates; no production candidate is selected.

stopping_conditions.requirement: At least two evidence-driven improvement iterations after the first baseline
stopping_conditions.note: More than two preregistered iterations, including negative branches, completed.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Preregistered effects, intervals, repeated-comparison caveats, and negative results reported
stopping_conditions.note: Completed for powered comparisons; tiny coverage runs are explicitly descriptive.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Relevant tests, lint, formatting, and type checking pass
stopping_conditions.note: Final verification on 2026-08-23: 219 tests, Ruff, format, and Pyright pass.

stopping_conditions.requirement: A genuinely access-separated Tier C holdout ran exactly once after finalist freeze
stopping_conditions.note: No access-separated holdout/operator exists and zero finalists qualify; synthetic fixtures are not evidence.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Three to five strong candidates frozen and two or three selected for human evaluation
Final intended-audience human evaluation completed and used for production recommendation
stopping_conditions.note: No valid packet or human rating exists; requesting ratings now would violate finalist readiness.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Results reproducible from committed code and manifests
stopping_conditions.note: Committed bytes rebuild deterministically; ignored raw/model prerequisites and exact hashes are explicit.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Costs, unresolved rights issues, limitations, and blocked profile runs reported honestly
stopping_conditions.note: Settled spend, unresolved rights, limitations, and every blocked profile run are reported honestly.

stopping_conditions.requirement: All paid resources shut down, settled spend at or below $100, and remaining budget documented
stopping_conditions.note: Settled spend is $0, no paid resource was started or remains, and the full $100 remains unapproved.

stopping_conditions.requirement: Final report recommends the best architecture and gives exact use and reproduction commands
stopping_conditions.note: A complete provisional report recommends no deployment and documents the research leader; a final production recommendation is impossible without Tier C and human confirmation.

unmet_completion_conditions: No candidate passes every hard gate; the best accepted local candidate passes 12 of 24.
No three-to-five-candidate finalist freeze or selected human packet is scientifically valid.
No genuinely access-separated Tier C holdout has run exactly once.
No intended-audience human results or judge-human calibration exist.
No authentic rough-to-final corpus is both available and training_approved for the highest-value next experiment.
next_external_trigger: User or counsel supplies a rights-cleared authentic rough-to-final corpus; after a new candidate passes 24 of 24 B1 gates and a clean output audit, a separately controlled operator supplies B2 and Tier C and intended-audience raters complete Tier D.
